title: Welcome to the Club of Hearts
body:
dang i finally set this up so it works.. i hope i can get to it often and speak - speak my mind.. talk more.. get more open.. as i once was... the world has silenced me... trauma .. but ive circled back and pin pointed all my failed moments.. and ive grown stronger - i love this .. this is awesome. life is good. sony and love rock... madi is awesome too.. she hates me for the most part but life is good. lets go. 

it was a tuff year 2026 - things were supposed to be great.... thieves came for us tho on every venture we took after the sale of our business.. the sharks really do come.... jesus.. in the name of jesus... seriously.. the more money.. the more problems... they can say that again... what a fkn year... there are unknown forces that will try to financially burden you when you try to cross and pass levels..... learning lessons become lessons you never wanted.. or needed... like shit... i thought money could make things move faster.... sometimes it just brings more demons into your life and sets you back.... art is what survives.... soul.... creation...  i knew that.. it took the world teaching it to us as a family... together.. again a lesson i never saw coming... we didnt need that lesson...  i dont think god was behind it.. i think hes actually seen it.. and was late.. he was late to the battle.. so hes sent angels to hold the line... and we been fighting the war - 2027 we are going to conquer many who stand in our path. we come with light we cast down anyone who tries to harm our flock. in Jesus' name Amen.
